pictures.name: first_light_on_an_empty_room
pictures.scene: a plain swept room taking the first low light of morning through one open shutter, the floor and the sill lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the walls above them quiet and brown and bare

pictures.name: lamp_carried_into_a_dark_room
pictures.scene: one raised oil lamp filling a windowless stone room with warm light so that no corner stays dark, the flame and the floor beneath it bright and low, the ceiling above soft and even and unhidden

pictures.name: footprints_in_wet_sand
pictures.scene: a line of deep clear footprints crossing wet sand at the edge of the tide, the nearest prints lit warm and low along the bottom of the frame, the flat shore and sky beyond them pale and open and still

pictures.name: sheltered_hollow_in_the_rock
pictures.scene: a smooth hollow worn into a great boulder and closed on every side but one, the warm light reaching just into its floor at the bottom of the frame, the curved stone above it dim and near and quiet

pictures.name: wide_horizon_on_every_side
pictures.scene: a level salt plain running out flat to the horizon in all directions, the cracked white ground lit warm and low along the bottom of the frame, the enormous sky above it clear and empty from edge to edge

pictures.name: stars_above_a_deep_chasm
pictures.scene: a narrow chasm cut deep into dark rock with a bright field of stars showing far above it, the near rim lit faintly at the bottom of the frame, the walls between them black and sheer and without any detail

pictures.name: dawn_over_the_open_sea
pictures.scene: a wide calm ocean taking the first gold of sunrise along its eastern edge, the near swell lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the vast sky above it opening pale and cool and completely empty

pictures.name: shuttered_room_at_noon
pictures.scene: a closed and shuttered room at midday with one hard blade of daylight cutting in across the floor, the lit boards warm and bright low in the frame, the shut dark above and around them heavy and deep

pictures.name: moonlight_bright_as_noon
pictures.scene: an open country of pale stone lying under a full moon so bright that every ridge and stone reads clearly, the near ground lit cool and clean, the sky above it luminous and wide and free of cloud

pictures.name: wool_on_the_loom
pictures.scene: a warm woollen cloth half woven on an upright loom with the threads drawn tight and even, the finished weave lit soft and gold at the bottom of the frame, the frame and wall above it dim and quiet

pictures.name: unfurling_fern
pictures.scene: one green fern frond opening out of its tight coil in deep shade, the curled tip lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the wet rock and leaves above and behind it dark and soft and still

pictures.name: seed_split_open_in_the_dark_earth
pictures.scene: a single seed split open underground with its first pale root reaching down through crumbled soil, the seed lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the packed earth above it deep and brown and close

pictures.name: tree_rings_in_cut_timber
pictures.scene: the sawn end of a great felled trunk with every growth ring showing clean and unbroken, the cut wood lit warm and even at the bottom of the frame, the bark and the forest floor above it dim and quiet

pictures.name: night_sky_thick_with_stars
pictures.scene: an immense night sky crowded from edge to edge with stars beyond counting, one low dark ridge lying quietly across the bottom of the frame, the whole depth above it open and luminous and unhurried

pictures.name: morning_light_across_a_bed_mat
pictures.scene: a woven sleeping mat on a swept floor with early sunlight lying warm and full across it, the near weave lit gold at the bottom of the frame, the plain room above it soft and brown and altogether calm

pictures.name: muddied_spring
pictures.scene: a small spring pool churned brown and opaque with silt, the disturbed water and its trampled rim lit low and dull at the bottom of the frame, the dry bank above it grey and bare and out of the light

pictures.name: thorn_thicket_choking_a_field
pictures.scene: a dense mass of grey thorn grown up over what was once a barley field, the tangled stems lit hard and low at the bottom of the frame, the choked ground beyond them flat and dim and colourless

pictures.name: chaff_blown_off_the_threshing_floor
pictures.scene: light chaff lifting and blowing away off a swept threshing floor in a steady wind, the clean grain and the floor lit warm and gold low in the frame, the air above them full of drifting pale dust

pictures.name: metal_bright_in_the_crucible
pictures.scene: a clay crucible of molten metal glowing white gold in a bed of coals, the pool of metal lit fierce and warm at the bottom of the frame, the dark forge above and around it deep and red and quiet

pictures.name: clear_path_over_the_ridge
pictures.scene: a plain footpath climbing steadily over a bare ridge and going on out of sight into open light, the near stones lit warm and clear, the long sky above the crest pale and wide and entirely untroubled

lines.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
O LORD, You have searched me
and known me.
You know when I sit and when I rise;
You understand my thoughts from afar.
You search out my path and my lying down;
You are aware of all my ways.
Even before a word is on my tongue,
You know all about it, O LORD.
You hem me in behind and before;
You have laid Your hand upon me.
Such knowledge is too wonderful for me,
too lofty for me to attain.
Where can I go to escape Your Spirit?
Where can I flee from Your presence?
If I ascend to the heavens, You are there;
if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.
If I rise on the wings of the dawn,
if I settle by the farthest sea,
even there Your hand will guide me;
Your right hand will hold me fast.
If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me,
and the light become night around me”—
even the darkness is not dark to You,
but the night shines like the day,
for darkness is as light to You.
For You formed my inmost being;
You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
I praise You,
for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
Marvelous are Your works,
and I know this very well.
My frame was not hidden from You
when I was made in secret,
when I was woven together
in the depths of the earth.
Your eyes saw my unformed body;
all my days were written in Your book
and ordained for me
before one of them came to be.
How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God,
how vast is their sum!
If I were to count them,
they would outnumber the grains of sand;
and when I awake,
I am still with You.
O God, that You would slay the wicked—
away from me, you bloodthirsty men—
who speak of You deceitfully;
Your enemies take Your name in vain.
Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD,
and detest those who rise against You?
I hate them with perfect hatred;
I count them as my enemies.
Search me, O God, and know my heart;
test me and know my concerns.
See if there is any offensive way in me;
lead me in the way everlasting.
